spm.faq.1.a: SPM ESS is an AI-powered speaking practice app designed to help SPM students improve their English speaking skills through real conversations, role-play scenarios, and instant feedback. Learning becomes active, engaging, and enjoyable — just like talking to a real person.
spm.faq.1.q: What is the SPM English Speaking Success (SPM ESS) App?
spm.faq.2.a: The app is designed for SPM students who want to build confidence in English speaking, improve fluency, and prepare effectively for the SPM English Speaking Test (Parts 1–3).
spm.faq.2.q: Who is the app designed for?
spm.faq.3.a: Yes. The content is closely aligned with the current SPM English curriculum and speaking assessment requirements. Practice tasks are designed to help students develop the communication skills expected in the SPM English Speaking Test.
spm.faq.3.q: Is the content aligned with the SPM English curriculum?
spm.faq.4.a: Yes. Students can practise personal response questions (Part 1), individual long-turn speaking tasks (Part 2), and discussion and opinion-sharing activities (Part 3). The app provides guided practice to help students organise ideas and respond more confidently.
spm.faq.4.q: Can the app help me prepare for Speaking Parts 1, 2, and 3?
spm.faq.5.a: The AI Coach acts as a speaking partner. Students can respond to questions verbally and engage in conversations similar to real speaking situations. The AI listens, responds, and provides feedback to help improve speaking performance.
spm.faq.5.q: How does the AI Coach work?
spm.faq.6.a: Yes. The app provides pronunciation practice and feedback to help students speak more clearly and accurately. Students can listen, repeat, and practise regularly to improve their spoken English.
spm.faq.6.q: Can the app improve my pronunciation?
spm.faq.7.a: Yes. Students can access a FREE trial version to explore selected features before deciding whether to upgrade to the full programme.
spm.faq.7.q: Is there a free trial available?
spm.faq.8.a: Simply register for a free account, download the app, and begin your free trial. Start practising today and take the first step towards becoming a more confident English speaker.

statement.contact: Should you detect any suspicious promotional materials misappropriating the Company's name or the aforementioned footage, please contact us immediately via Email at info@lango.ai or Tel at +852 9354 1948. The Company reserves all legal rights to pursue action against any institution or individual that falsely uses our name or damages our corporate reputation.
statement.footer: Please rely only on information published on this website and our official channels.
statement.greeting: To all our valued clients, partners, and members of the public:
statement.intro: Lango Innovation Limited (hereinafter referred to as "the Company") has recently identified individuals falsely claiming to be interview teams from national media outlets or authorized agencies. These individuals have been conducting unauthorized interviews at commercial exhibitions, attempting to lure businesses to cross-border locations under the guise of commercial selections, and demanding exorbitant fees. To protect the public interest and safeguard our corporate reputation, the Company hereby issues the following solemn statement:
statement.section1.body: During our participation in "Learning & Teaching Expo 2026" in late June 2026, the Company was approached for a brief on-site interview by a photography and editorial team claiming to represent "China Central Television (CCTV)". Following a strict internal review, the Company has confirmed that this team was NOT officially authorized or affiliated with CCTV, and their subsequent commercial events bear no relation to CCTV. The Company immediately refused to participate and has terminated all communications with said party.
statement.section1.title: No Collaboration with the Mentioned Entities:
statement.section2.body: During the aforementioned process, certain interview clips, photographs of our person-in-charge, and brief self-introduction videos were captured by the party under the pretext of an audition. The Company hereby strictly declares: The Company has never authorized any fraudulent media or unverified media agencies to use any of the aforementioned materials. Any entity or individual utilizing these clips, photographs, or the Company's name for any commercial promotion, recruitment, business selection, or financial solicitation is committing infringement and fraud, which has absolutely no connection with the Company.
statement.section2.title: No Authorization for Using Captured Footage and Images:
statement.section3.body: In response to this suspected case of fraud involving the impersonation of a media organization, the Company has officially filed a report and record with the e-Report Centre of the Hong Kong Police Force (case legally recorded) to prevent the unauthorized footage from being maliciously used for illegal purposes.
statement.section3.title: Report Filed with Law Enforcement:
statement.section4.body: The Company adheres strictly to the principles of integrity and business ethics. We will never participate in any unauthorized evaluation or promotional campaigns requiring on-the-spot payments of "deposits" or "promotional fees". We urge our clients, industry peers, and the public to remain highly vigilant against such fraudulent schemes.
statement.section4.title: Notice of Public Vigilance:
statement.title: Clarification on Fraudulent Media Interviews and Anti-Scam Notice
storyworld.character.chris.bio: The tech-savvy main character who is passionate, curious, and a bit mischievous. Accompanied by his talking pet parrot who helps him learn English, his goal is to visit Jessica during the summer holiday.
storyworld.character.dan.bio: Chris's long-time best friend, easily spotted by his chubby build, overalls, and warm smile. Despite struggling in school, he is remarkably cheerful and always tries to cheer Chris up when he feels down.
storyworld.character.jessica.bio: Chris's foreign friend and exchange student, recognizable by her pink curly hair, green eyes, and bright personality. As a top student who loves reading and cultures, she helps Chris practice his English.
storyworld.character.ryan.bio: A tall, athletic classmate whose intense competitiveness and jealousy over Jessica spark frequent rivalries with Chris. Deep down, he has a softer side with close friends and eventually learns the value of teamwork.
storyworld.character.uncle_tommy.bio: Chris's fun-loving English teacher and class teacher who loves joking with his students and acting as their hero in tough times. Though a bit stingy, unlucky, and easily annoyed, Chris trusts him deeply.

storyworld.storyline.desc: Follow connected story arcs across missions, chapters, and character meet-ups. Each storyline weaves vocabulary, dialogue, and real-world themes into adventures learners want to finish.
